import type { Camera } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import {
  getViewMatrix,
  getViewProjectionMatrix,
  getEffectiveAspectRatio,
  resolveCameraViewport,
  projectWorldToScreen,
  getCameraPosition
} from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function labelPosition(camera: Camera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, point: {x:number;y:number;z:number}) {
  const cssWidth = canvas.clientWidth || canvas.getBoundingClientRect().width;
  const cssHeight = canvas.clientHeight || canvas.getBoundingClientRect().height;
  const backingWidth = canvas.width;
  const backingHeight = canvas.height;
  if (!cssWidth || !cssHeight || !backingWidth || !backingHeight) return {x:0,y:0,visible:false};
  const aspect = getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  const viewport = resolveCameraViewport(camera, backingWidth, backingHeight);
  const view = getViewMatrix(camera);
  const viewProjection = getViewProjectionMatrix(camera, aspect);
  const options: any = { viewport, backingWidth, backingHeight, cssWidth, cssHeight };
  if (camera._useFloatingOrigin) options.worldOrigin = getCameraPosition(camera);
  const projected = projectWorldToScreen(point, view, viewProjection, options);
  return { x: projected.cssX, y: projected.cssY, visible: !projected.behindCamera && !projected.offscreen };
}
